name: Modern (x86-64)
description: 64-bit Garry's Mod branch for better performance.
startup_command: export HOME=/home/container; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/container/bin/linux64:/home/container/bin:/home/container; ./srcds_run_x64 -game garrysmod -console -port {{SERVER_PORT}} +ip 0.0.0.0 +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} +gamemode {{GAMEMODE}} -strictportbind -norestart $( [ -n "{{STEAM_TOKEN}}" ] && printf '+sv_setsteamaccount %s' "{{STEAM_TOKEN}}" ) +maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -tickrate {{TICKRATE}} $( [ "$LUA_REFRESH" == "1" ] || printf %s '-disableluarefresh' )
script_install:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

install -d -m 0770 /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /tmp
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd

export HOME=/mnt/server
export LANG=C.UTF-8
export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
STEAMCMD=/mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh

echo "[Atlas] SteamCMD phase 1/3: Updating SteamCMD"
"$STEAMCMD" +login anonymous +quit || true

echo "[Atlas] SteamCMD phase 2/3: Downloading GMod x86-64 Windows files"
"$STEAMCMD" +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 4020 -beta x86-64 validate +quit

echo "[Atlas] SteamCMD phase 3/3: Downloading GMod x86-64 Linux files"
"$STEAMCMD" +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update 4020 -beta x86-64 validate +quit

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/srcds_run_x64 ]; then
    echo "[Atlas] Error: SteamCMD completed without installing srcds_run_x64." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "[Atlas] Finalizing 64-bit Steam libraries..."
install -D -m 0644 /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
install -D -m 0644 /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/bin/linux64/steamclient.so
find /mnt/server -maxdepth 1 -type f -name "srcds*" -exec chmod u+x {} +
